senses.gloss:
—1 Impurity, dirtiness, foulness; Pt. 1. 195.
—2 Legal impurity or contamination; defilement caused either by child-birth
 (called जननाशौच) or by the death of some relation (called मृताशौच);
 it lasts for 10 days; during the मृताशौच a person defiled by it is
 not to touch anybody else, or to eat with others in the same row or to
 do any sacred action; अहोरात्रमुपासीरन्नशौचं बान्धवैः सह Ms. 11. 183.
.━{@Comp.@}: अशौचान्तः, अशौचसंकरः

आशौचम् [अशुचेर्भावः अण्; P. VII. 3. 30] Impurity, see अशौचम्;
 दशाहं शावमाशौचं सपिण्डेषु विधीयते Ms. 5. 59, 61, 62, 74, 80; Y. 3. 18.
अशौचम् + -संकरः blending or coming together of two or more defilements.
अशौण्डीर्यम् Illiberality अशौण्डीर्यस्वभावेन वेशभावेन मन्यते Mk. 8. 17.

असौनामन् a. Ved. Having such and such a name. असौ नामायमिदं
 रूपः Bṛ. Up. 1. 4. 7.

असौम्य a. Not lovely, ugly, disagreeable; ˚कृत्^1 a. Troublesome;
 ममापि सोऽपराध्नोति यो युष्माकमसौम्यकृत् Mb. 8. 33. 41. ˚स्वर
 a. having a bad or croaking voice.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251211. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/102.

असौष्ठव a.
—1 Devoid of beauty or loveliness, not in good trim; शरीरमसौष्ठवम् Māl. 1. 17.
—2 Ugly, deformed.
